| τὸν δ’ αὖτε προσέειπε Γερήνιος ἱππότα Νέστωρ (10.168, whole-line reply-formula, the αὖτε counterpart of the fixed τὸν δ’ ἠμείβετ’ ἔπειτα Γερήνιος ἱππότα Νέστωρ) | "Him then in turn addressed the Gerenian horseman Nestor:" | "Then the Gerenian horseman Nestor spoke to him in turn:" | "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο); kept on the pattern of τὸν δ’ αὖτε προσέειπεν ἄναξ ἀνδρῶν Ἀγαμέμνων (9.114 = 10.119) and the Odyssey’s τὸν δ’ αὖτε προσέειπε rows |
| ἀμήχανος (of Nestor, σὺ δ’ ἀμήχανός ἐσσι γεραιέ, 10.167; departure from the Odyssey’s "helpless", 19.363) | "past all dealing with" | "impossible to deal with" | "helpless" (the Odyssey’s word: it would say that Nestor can do nothing, where the point is that nothing can be done with him), "resourceless", "unmanageable"; ἀ- + μηχανή as in the table, the sense taken from the Iliad context |
| ἀωτεῖς (πάννυχον ὕπνον ἀωτεῖς, 10.159; rare verb, formation not certain) | "do you slumber" | "are you slumbering" | "sleep" (reserved for εὕδω), "doze", "snore"; follows the Odyssey’s ἀωτεῖτε (10.548) "slumber" |
